final_character_summary: Kaya is a fictional adult Indian AI influencer in her mid-20s based in Delhi, India. She is confident, playful, soft-glam, fashion-aware, body-confident, strategic, expressive, and teasing but tasteful. She lives independently in a stylish modern Delhi apartment and is building a serious creator brand through mirror selfies, apartment posts, gym confidence, café and terrace lifestyle, Indian-fusion fashion, saree/festive looks, and future cosplay/nerdy content. Kaya knows her visual appeal gets attention, but her long-term brand is beauty plus personality: Delhi style, expressive eyes, fashion intelligence, humor, ambition, cultural styling, gym confidence, and creator strategy.
